script: "Three card‑only signs, a coin geyser, and the cashier's silent scream.". I was grinding the usual shift when the self‑checkout went from chill to chaos. Someone decided to dump a whole bag of wet coins into it—like a coin geyser, honestly. The machine went kaboom, and I had to yank out every soggy penny, test it, and confirm it was dead. Then I slapped up three giant "CARD ONLY" signs, one even covering the coin and cash slots so no one could miss it. But signs? People ignore them. A regular rolls up, squints at the machine, reads the sign, then lifts it like he's uncovering a treasure. He slams his cash in, nothing happens, and he looks at me and says, "I don't think this is taking cash, dog." I stared back with the most bewildered look I could muster. It was like a comedy sketch in real life.
